description: Kindi 0.5: local LLM inference on low-cost NVIDIA GPUs (Kepler to the RTX 50 series and the CMP 170HX), AMD Radeon 780M, 840M and 8060S, and CPUs. Bonsai 2B-27B, AH-Nanbeige4.3-33B and experimental Nemotron, with an OpenAI-compatible server.
